about: A message's envelope and its parts (PROTOCOL.md, "A message's parts"). `compose`: the fields a client sends (`kuvo/sessions/<id>/send`), who's around (`agents`, everyone "&" can name; `here`, the box it's on, null on a Mac's own; `excluding`, the conversation it's written in), the files the box keeps of those it carries (`kept`) and whether it's from a phone, to the text the agent reads (`text`, as Kuvo Code wrote it before the box did, byte for byte) and its parts. `read`: a message from before, as written, to its parts. The box's test (message-parts.test.ts) holds both directions; KuvoClient's (MessagePartsTests) reads every `parts` as a client does and sends every `fields` as the box takes them.
